name: Owl Insights (NeuroFlow)

acquisition.notes: Owl was acquired by NeuroFlow in June 2024, creating the largest end-to-end behavioral health measurement and engagement platform

short_description: Enterprise behavioral health measurement and engagement platform with 400+ assessments, AI-powered risk detection, and population health analytics. Now part of NeuroFlow.
long_description: Owl Insights (now part of NeuroFlow) is an enterprise-grade behavioral health measurement-based care and analytics platform. Originally founded in 2013 as Mental Health Data Services, Owl was acquired by NeuroFlow in June 2024, creating the largest end-to-end platform for behavioral health measurement and engagement. The combined platform offers over 400 behavioral health assessments in multiple languages, automated bi-directional EHR integration, AI/NLP-powered risk detection including suicidal ideation screening, and comprehensive population health analytics. NeuroFlow's BHIQ analytics layer aggregates claims, EMR encounters, pharmacy data, and consumer-generated data for population-level risk management. The platform supports over 17 million lives across 300+ health systems, payers, and organizations in all 50 states.
one_liner: Enterprise behavioral health measurement and analytics platform, now part of NeuroFlow.

faqs.q: Is Owl Insights still available after the NeuroFlow acquisition?
faqs.a: Yes, Owl's measurement-based care capabilities are now fully integrated into NeuroFlow's platform. Existing Owl customers continue to receive support, and the combined platform offers enhanced features.

faqs.q: How many assessments does the NeuroFlow/Owl platform offer?
faqs.a: The combined platform offers over 400 behavioral health assessments in multiple languages, including PHQ-9, GAD-7, Columbia Suicide Scale, PCL-5, and many more.

BHIQ is NeuroFlow's behavioral health analytics layer that aggregates claims, EMR encounters, pharmacy data, and consumer-generated data to support population-level risk management for payers and providers.
